display.title: {"text": "End Expeditions"}
description: Nullscape's End: end cities, End castles and lighthouses, wrecks drifting over the void.
&ePrepare:&r Elytra or slow falling, feather falling, ender pearls, ranged weapons for shulkers.
&eSignature rewards:&r Starlit Voidglass (exchange for Endersurge/Mageslayer gems), elytra, Ancient Cores, rare Starforged Hearts in city treasure.
&eComing back:&r The outer End is effectively endless; cities repeat with variety thanks to Nullscape terrain.
&eFeeds into:&r Voidglass -> end gems; hearts -> late tech.
&aObjective:&r Step inside any structure of this family.
&bWhy it matters:&r Knowing what a family offers before you go makes the trip worth it.
